text: ① 14:15 欧洲央行管委Sleijpen讲话在一场关于气候变化、央行、宏观经济的活动上讲话； ② 15:00 欧洲央行管委Simkus、欧洲央行执行委员会成员Isabel Schnabel讲话； ③ 15:45 法国10月CPI终值； ④ 16:30 欧洲央行管委Zigman讲话； ⑤ 17:00 国际能源署（IEA）公布月度原油市场报告； ⑥ 18:00 欧元区三季度GDP修正值； ⑦ 21:30 美国10月PPI； ⑧ 22:10 美国波士顿联储主席Collins在该联储关于美国住房市场的第70届经济活动上发表开场白讲话； ⑨ 22:40 美国达
text_en: ① 14:15 ECB Governing Council member Sleijpen speaks at an event on climate change, central banks, and the macroeconomy; ② 15:00 ECB Governing Council member Simkus and ECB Executive Board member Isabel Schnabel speak; ③ 15:45 France October final CPI; ④ 16:30 ECB Governing Council member Zigman speaks; ⑤ 17:00 International Energy Agency (IEA) releases its monthly oil market report; ⑥ 18:00 Eurozone Q3 GDP revised figures; ⑦ 21:30 US October PPI; ⑧ 22:10 Boston Fed President Collins delivers opening remarks at the Boston Fed's 70th economic policy conference on the US housing market; ⑨ 22:40 US Dallas
